fact_check.claim: Airport parking formula: ITH = whole weeks x $40 + min(leftover days x $8, $40); SYR = days x $14; 5 days ITH $40, SYR $70; 14 days ITH $80, SYR $196
fact_check.note: Recomputed: 5 days: 0x40 + min(40,40) = 40; 5x14 = 70. 14 days: 2x40 + min(0,40) = 80; 14x14 = 196. The JS in tool.html uses the same formula. Page states the weekly-rate/partial-week assumption openly.
